Founded in 2007 and listed in Frankfurt since 2021, the Berlin-based company offers eye exams, fittings, and a wide selection of frames, lenses, and contacts.

name: Moai.cash
description: Moai.cash is a decentralized financial super app on Telegram offering zero-fee transactions, a crypto wallet, and prediction markets.

name: mobilike
description: #1 mobile advertising platform in Turkey

name: Modern Relay
description: Modern Relay is the context graph for agent-native teams - the governed foundation where agents, teams and systems share context, coordinate work and compound knowledge.

name: Modix (exit)
description: SaaS solution for car dealerships Acquired by Mannheim (US)

name: Mokker.ai
description: Mokker.ai is an AI-powered product photography platform that turns simple product shots into studio-quality images. It removes backgrounds, offers customizable scenes and templates, and generates on‑brand visuals for e‑commerce, marketplaces, and ads—without a physical photoshoot.

name: Momox
description: Momox (one of Christoph's angel investments before starting P9) is Europe’s leading re-commerce platform for used books, media, and fashion. Founded in 2004 in Berlin, it buys items online at fixed prices and resells them via storefronts like medimops, extending product lifecycles and promoting circular consumption.

name: myGengo
description: Crowd-sourcing translation platform

name: MyMuesli
description: Custom breakfast cereal mixes

name: Netzathleten
description: Network of sport related portals Acquired by RTL

name: NexHealth
description: Founded in 2017, NexHealth streamlines the patient journey—from booking to intake, reminders, and payments—by syncing directly with practice EHRs. The company also provides a universal EHR API, enabling developers to build healthcare apps that integrate across dozens of systems.

name: Odyssey
description: Odyssey is an AI research lab building world models — systems that learn the physics, causality, and dynamics of the real world well enough to generate video you can move through and interact with in real time. Its Odyssey-2 model streams minutes-long, explorable simulations from a single text or image prompt.

name: Oferteo
description: Oferteo is Poland’s largest online marketplace connecting people and companies seeking services with vetted contractors across home, construction, and business categories. The platform generates over 2 million requests annually and helps 700,000+ providers win new customers.

name: Omnea
description: Omnea is an AI-native procurement and supplier relationship management platform that streamlines intake, approvals, and renewals, centralizes supplier data, and automates third‑party risk and performance workflows across systems.

name: Ontruck
description: Ontruck is a European digital road‑freight platform that connects shippers with vetted carriers for full and part‑load palletized goods. Founded in Madrid in 2016, it uses real‑time tracking and route optimization to reduce empty miles, cut CO2, and deliver reliable, cost‑efficient transport across Spain and neighboring markets.

name: Pageflakes
description: Personalized startpage Acquired by LiveUniverse

name: Pento
description: Pento is a UK-focused payroll automation platform that lets companies run payroll in minutes with real-time calculations, HMRC and pension integrations, and error-reducing workflows. In 2024, Pento was acquired by HRIS provider HiBob to power native UK payroll within Bob.

name: PersistIQ
description: PersistIQ is a sales engagement and prospecting platform that helps small and mid-sized teams find new customers, personalize multi-channel outreach, and automate tasks across email, calls, and CRM. Acquired by Wishpond in 2021.

name: Petsapp
description: Petsapp is a client communication and payments platform for veterinary clinics, offering SMS and WhatsApp chat, appointment booking, video consults, reminders, and digital payments – helping teams streamline workflows and improve the pet owner experience.

name: PlayPlay
description: PlayPlay is an AI-powered video creation platform that helps marketing and communications teams turn messages into professional, on‑brand videos in minutes – no editing skills required. Templates, brand kits, and automated captions, voiceovers, and translations let teams scale video across channels with consistency.

name: Podcastle
description: Async (formerly Podcastle) empowers creators and teams by radically simplifying the end-to-end content creation process. The streamlined suite of AI-powered tools enables users to record, edit, transcribe, and publish audio and video content with unmatched simplicity. Originally founded in 2020 as a Chrome extension that instantly converted articles into podcasts, the platform rapidly evolved base

name: Polar Analytics
description: Polar Analytics is an all-in-one ecommerce analytics platform for Shopify and omnichannel brands, unifying data from storefronts, ad platforms, and other sources into a single source of truth.

name: Pomocni
description: Founded in 2008 around the Niania.pl domain, Pomocni runs six niche platforms that match families with vetted caregivers and home services across Poland. Today, the group is owned by Burda Media Home, part of Burda Media Polska.

name: Poolside
description: Poolside is a frontier lab building the most capable foundation models, agents, and enterprise systems to deploy them, starting with software development. Founded by Eiso Kant (founder of Athenian, a P9 portfolio company) and former GitHub CTO Jason Warner.

name: Positionly
description: SEO analytics platform

name: Preply
description: Preply is a global online language learning marketplace that connects learners with expert tutors for 1-on-1 video lessons, using AI to personalize progress. With 100,000+ tutors across 90+ languages, it serves learners in 180+ countries.

name: Procurify
description: Procurify helps finance and operations teams manage purchasing and AP in one place, with budgets, approvals, vendor management, and smart spend cards that track spend in real time. Its AI-enhanced platform provides end-to-end visibility from request through payment.

name: Procuros
description: Procuros builds an AI-powered B2B Integration Hub for retail and FMCG, unifying EDI, APIs, and supplier portals to exchange orders, delivery notes, and invoices seamlessly with thousands of partners.

name: Project Europe
description: Project Europe is an initiative that brings together leading European founders, operators, and investors to support the next generation of startup builders through community, mentorship, and shared resources.

name: Propertybase
description: One of Christoph's angel investments before P9, Propertybase was a CRM solution specifically for the real estate industry. Acquired by Boston Logic in 2017.

name: Purmeo
description: Purmeo is a Berlin-based nutrition brand offering high-quality supplements – from probiotics to targeted micronutrient complexes – designed to support gut, immune, and everyday wellness.

name: Qlub
description: Qlub provides QR-powered pay-at-table, order-and-pay, and digital menu solutions for restaurants, hotels, and lounges. Diners scan a QR code to view the menu, split and settle the bill in seconds while venues boost table turns, tips, and operational efficiency.

name: Qwilr
description: Qwilr is a modern proposal and quoting platform that turns sales documents into interactive web pages with e‑signature, payments, and detailed analytics, connected to CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. Founded in Sydney in 2014, it helps B2B teams move faster and win more deals.

name: Recast Systems
description: Recast Systems is a privately held climate technology company based in San Francisco, California.

name: REKKI
description: REKKI connects restaurants with their suppliers, letting chefs browse products, place and track orders, chat in real time, and handle payments in one place. Suppliers use REKKI to streamline order intake and get paid faster, with AI‑powered tools that reduce errors and bad debt.

name: rekord
description: Rekord is an AI-native platform that enables financial institutions to design, scale, and monitor intelligent decision flows across underwriting, onboarding, compliance, and fraud. It unifies models, data, and policies to operationalize AI with guardrails and real-time observability.

name: Remerge
description: Remerge is a leading demand-side platform (DSP) for high-performing app marketing campaigns. Founded in Berlin in 2014, the company operates globally with a strong privacy-first approach.

name: Reonic
description: Reonic is a vertical software platform for renewable energy installers. By unifying lead capture, system design, simulation, digital proposals, and project management Reonic helps teams sell, size, and deliver solar, storage, and heat pump projects faster and more profitably.

name: rerun
description: Rerun builds the data stack for Physical AI, with an open-source SDK and viewer to log, sync, and visualize multimodal data from robotics and computer vision in real time. Teams use Rerun to debug, explore, and share interactive views locally or at scale.

name: Rerun.io
description: Rerun is an open-source toolkit that aids programmers in creating effective visualizations.

name: Revolut
description: Revolut is the leading global neobank. Founded in London in 2015, Revolut has become a global financial super app, unifying everyday money management – spend, send, save, invest, and business finances – in a single platform.

name: riskmethods
description: Founded in 2013 in Munich, riskmethods provides supply chain risk management software that continuously monitors global threats, scores supplier exposure, and guides mitigation to keep operations resilient and compliant. The company was acquired by Sphera in 2022.

name: Rizm
description: RIZM's software platform integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure to algorithmically optimize industrial energy systems. Founded in 2020, RIZM helps manufacturers cut costs, reduce emissions, and stay resilient amid energy market volatility.

name: Rollbox
description: Rollbox built an API-first payroll engine that automated multi-country payroll processing for businesses and platforms. Founded in Spain, it offered developer-friendly integrations to run and reconcile payroll at scale. The company was acquired by Personio in 2019.

name: Roomorama
description: Roomorama was a marketplace for professionally managed vacation and short‑term rentals, offering apartments and homes worldwide with secure, instant bookings. Founded in 2009 by Federico Folcia and Jia En Teo, the company ceased operations in 2017.

name: Rooser
description: Rooser was a B2B seafood marketplace based in Edinburgh, connecting European buyers and suppliers with real-time pricing, quality data, and logistics tools to cut waste and improve transparency.

name: Root Global
description: Root Global builds climate intelligence and an end-to-end platform for agricultural supply chains, enabling food and beverage companies to accurately measure, report, and reduce supply chain emissions based on primary data.

name: samedi
description: Founded in 2008 in Berlin, samedi offers a secure patient engagement and scheduling platform for hospitals and medical practices. Acquired by Meierhofer AG in 2017, samedi was one of Christoph’s angel investments prior to Point Nine.

name: Savedo
description: Savedo was a Berlin-based marketplace for retail investment products, letting savers access competitive term deposits from partner banks across Europe. Acquired by Deposit Solutions in 2017, it was later integrated into the combined Raisin/Deposit Solutions group.

name: Scondoo
description: Scondoo is a Berlin-based cashback app that helps shoppers save on groceries and drugstore purchases: snap a receipt, redeem offers, and get money back across major retailers. Founded in 2012, Scondoo was acquired by UK-based CheckoutSmart in 2017.

name: ScreenCloud
description: ScreenCloud is a cloud-based digital signage platform that lets organizations manage and broadcast content, dashboards, and employee comms to any screen at scale.

name: Sensmore
description: Sensmore pioneers embodied AI and vision-based localization (VLAM) for heavy machinery in mining, construction, and related industries. The company retrofits off-highway vehicles with full-stack autonomy, enabling them to perceive, plan, and operate safely and efficiently in the world’s harshest environments.

name: Sereact
description: Sereact develops VLA AI that acts as a production-ready brain for robots, enabling zero-shot autonomy in real-world warehouses and industrial settings. Its system lets robots see, reason, and manipulate varied items across arms, mobile manipulators, and more.

name: Server Density
description: Server Density was a SaaS platform for monitoring servers, websites, and cloud infrastructure. Founded in 2009 and acquired by StackPath in 2018, Server Density was one of Christoph’s angel investments prior to Point Nine.

name: Shapr3D
description: Shapr3D builds a cross-platform, direct-modeling CAD app for iPad, Mac, Windows, and Apple Vision Pro. It brings precise, touch-friendly modeling to designers and engineers, streamlining sketching, 3D modeling, and drawings, with robust import/export for manufacturing workflows and integration with major CAD formats.

name: Shiftplanning
description: SaaS solution for employee scheduling

name: Showbie
description: Showbie is a K–12 learning platform used by millions of students and educators to manage classroom workflows, deliver assessments, and provide personalized feedback.

name: Soba
description: Soba is an online multiplayer open world and gaming platform with no-code game-making tools, enabling anyone to build, share, and play 3D games across devices.

name: Soda
description: Soda is a data quality and observability platform that helps data and AI teams test, monitor, and prevent issues across pipelines in real time. Built for modern data stacks, Soda blends automated checks with collaborative workflows to deliver trusted, production-grade data.

name: Soda Data
description: Soda is the data monitoring platform that keeps your data fit for purpose, verifiable, and trustworthy. We uncover data issues, alert the right teams, and trigger resolution workflows to identify causes that impede data quality. Our open source testing projects and monitoring platform bring together data engineers, operations, and the business to create trusted data. Data-driven organisations choo

name: Solarize
description: Solarize provides a modular software platform that orchestrates EV charging, photovoltaic generation, batteries, and dynamic tariffs across properties and fleets. Utilities, real estate operators, and EPCs use it to optimize energy flows and automate metering, billing, and load management.

name: Spacebase
description: Spacebase is a booking platform for workshop spaces, meeting rooms and events.

name: Spinnakr
description: Targeted messaging for websites

name: SponsorPay
description: Ad Monetization Platform Acquired by RNTS Media

name: Spreadshirt
description: Mass-customized ecommerce for t-shirts

name: Sqreen
description: Founded in 2015, Sqreen built developer-friendly AppSec, combining in-app monitoring and protection to surface vulnerabilities and stop attacks in real time. The company was acquired by Datadog in 2021; Point Nine was an early backer.

name: StarOfService
description: Founded in 2012 in Paris, StarOfService is an online marketplace that connects consumers with local professionals across hundreds of services – from home improvement to photography – by collecting requests, matching pros, and enabling quotes and bookings.

name: Storefront
description: Storefront, founded in 2014, is an online marketplace that makes offline retail accessible on demand by connecting brands with short-term retail spaces for pop-ups and experiential stores across major global cities. Acquired by PopUp Immo, a company specializing in short-term retail space rentals.

name: studiVZ (exit)
description: #1 student network in Germany Acquired by Holtzbrinck

name: StuDocu
description: StuDocu is a global student-to-student learning platform where learners share and discover course-specific study materials, now enhanced by AI tools for quizzes and flashcards. Founded in 2013 in the Netherlands, it serves tens of millions of students worldwide.

name: StyleSeat
description: StyleSeat is a marketplace and business platform for beauty and barber professionals, helping them get discovered by new clients and run operations with online booking, scheduling, payments, and marketing tools. Founded in 2011, it connects millions of clients with independent stylists across the U.S.

name: SuperAnnotate
description: SuperAnnotate is an end-to-end data platform for multimodal AI that unifies dataset creation, curation, labeling, and quality management with model evaluation and fine-tuning. Teams use it to accelerate computer vision and GenAI workflows, deliver better models, and manage data at scale.

name: Superpopcorn
description: Superpopcorn was a Germany-based mobile platform that helped users browse showtimes and reserve or buy cinema tickets quickly and securely.

name: Tenderly
description: Tenderly is a full‑stack Web3 infrastructure and developer platform for EVM chains, combining high‑performance Node RPC and a Web3 Gateway with Virtual TestNets, transaction simulation, debugging, monitoring, and alerting to help teams build, ship, and scale dapps with end‑to‑end observability.

name: Tengo
description: Tengo is an AI-powered platform that helps companies find, qualify, and respond to public tenders at scale. It centralizes opportunities, automates analysis and answer drafting, and streamlines collaboration from discovery to submission for faster, higher-quality bids.

name: Thalamed
description: Thalamed was a B2B marketplace that helped doctors, clinics, and hospitals find, compare, and purchase medical equipment by requesting quotes from leading manufacturers. Acquired in 2021.

name: TheBrief
description: TheBrief (formerly Creatopy) is an AI agency that unifies ad creation, campaign launch, and optimization. It helps teams run ads directly to major channels, generate dynamic creatives at scale, and leverage AI agents for ongoing recommendations and faster, more consistent results.

name: Tier
description: Founded in Berlin in 2018, Tier built a leading shared micromobility platform for e‑scooters and e‑bikes across Europe and beyond, focused on safe, sustainable urban transport. In 2024, Tier merged with Dott to create one of Europe’s largest operators.

name: Tier Mobility
description: Changing urban mobility for good.

name: TradeLink
description: TradeLink is a logistics collaboration platform that digitizes delivery coordination between warehouses, suppliers, and carriers – covering slot booking, dock and yard management, driver check-in, and load carrier tracking – to make inbound flows predictable, cut waiting times, and improve on-time performance.
industry_tags: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

name: Tripaneer
description: Tripaneer is a leading marketplace for multi-day, themed travel experiences, spanning yoga and meditation retreats, surf camps, safaris, culinary vacations, and more. Founded in 2013 and based in Amsterdam, it helps travelers discover and safely book unforgettable trips worldwide.

name: Trivago
description: Hotel search and comparison Acquired by Expedia

name: Typeform
description: Typeform, founded in Barcelona in 2012, helps businesses collect insights and leads through beautifully designed, conversational forms, surveys, and quizzes. Today, Typeform has evolved into an AI-powered engagement platform, where users can build and edit interactive forms instantly using natural language prompts.

name: Unamo
description: Founded in 2012 as Positionly and later rebranded to Unamo, the company provided an integrated platform for SEO ranking, on-page optimization, and social media monitoring to help teams manage and grow their online presence.

name: Unbounce
description: Unbounce, founded in 2009 in Vancouver, was one of the first and leading platforms for building high-converting landing pages without code. Over time it expanded into a conversion intelligence platform, adding several AI tools to further boost performance and ROI.

name: Upciti
description: Paris-based Upciti provides urban intelligence via on‑device computer vision sensors and software that turn real‑time street activity into actionable metrics for traffic, infrastructure, and livability. Used by municipalities worldwide, Upciti processes data locally to protect citizens’ privacy.

name: UpCodes
description: UpCodes is a comprehensive building-code compliance platform for architects, engineers, and contractors. Founded in 2016, it unifies searchable codes across jurisdictions, collaboration tools, and Copilot – an AI assistant that answers project-specific code questions with cited sections.
locations: University of Texas at Austin, Austin, TX, USA

name: Userfox
description: Userfox built tools to design and send behavior-triggered, personalized emails, enabling startups and SaaS companies to onboard, engage, and retain users. The Y Combinator–backed company was acquired by AdRoll in 2014 to expand its CRM and email capabilities.

name: Vend
description: Founded in Auckland in 2010, Vend built one of the first cloud POS systems for independent retailers, offering inventory, multi-store, loyalty, and real-time reporting. Backed early by Point Nine, Vend was acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, where its technology continues to power modern retail operations.

name: Vercept
description: Founded by world-class AI researchers in Seattle, Vercept is training a foundational model for how computers use computers. Its product, Vy, lets you command your machine with natural language, navigating apps, content, and context seamlessly.

name: Vev
description: Vev provides free, modern software for independent professionals and small teams to run service businesses end-to-end. The platform offers online booking, payments, scheduling, team management, and lightweight CRM.

name: Vital
description: Junction (formerly VITAL) allows developers to access health data from wearable devices and at-home test kits. The company was founded in 2021 by Maitham Dib and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

name: Westwing
description: Westwing offers a curated online destination for furniture, lighting, textiles, and accessories, alongside its private-label Westwing Collection. Headquartered in Munich and active across Europe, the company was founded in 2011 and is publicly listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.

name: Whereby
description: Whereby provides secure, no-download video meetings and a developer-friendly video API used across telehealth, education, and customer support. Founded in Norway as appear.in in 2013 and rebranded in 2019, the company focuses on simplicity, customization, and privacy-first design.

name: Wikifarmer
description: Wikifarmer is a global platform that empowers farmers with free, expert-led education and a B2B marketplace to sell directly to verified buyers. It promotes fair, transparent agri-food trade and traceability while helping buyers source quality, sustainably produced goods.

name: WIRKAUFENS
description: Trade-in service for used consumer electronics

name: Workerbase
description: Workerbase helps factories modernize operations with a no-code connected worker suite for digital work instructions, task management, alerts, and data capture – linking people, machines, and IT systems. Manufacturers use it to boost productivity, quality, and agility without rebuilding the shop floor.

name: xChange
description: Container xChange helps logistics companies buy, sell, and lease shipping containers worldwide on a trusted marketplace, with tools for tracking, partner vetting, and secure payments. Headquartered in Hamburg, the company serves thousands of members across global hubs.

name: Xeneta
description: Xeneta is the leading ocean and air freight rate benchmarking and market intelligence platform, using crowdsourced data to deliver real-time pricing, capacity, and index insights that help shippers, forwarders, and carriers benchmark, plan, and negotiate better.

name: Yogaia
description: Yogaia is an online wellness platform offering live and on-demand yoga, Pilates, strength, and mindfulness classes you can join from anywhere. Founded in Finland in 2013, it pioneered live, interactive sessions with optional camera-on feedback to bring studio energy home.

name: Zauber
description: Zauber is building the AI operating system for logistics, unifying tools like spot rate requests and TMS booking to automate planning and execution across the supply chain. Founded by Erik Muttersbach, co-founder of Forto, one of Europe’s largest digital freight forwarders, Zauber applies deep industry expertise to streamline global freight workflows through an integrated, AI-first platform.

name: Zenaton
description: Zenaton was a developer-focused workflow orchestration platform that automated and supervised complex business processes, handling retries and powering event-driven background jobs with simple code across workers and queues.

name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk builds customer service and experience software used by businesses to support, engage, and retain customers across email, chat, messaging, voice, and AI. Founded in Copenhagen in 2007 and now headquartered in San Francisco, Zendesk went public in 2014 and was taken private in 2022.

name: ZenML
description: ZenML is an open-source MLOps and LLMOps framework that helps teams build reproducible, production-ready ML pipelines across any stack. Its code-first, pipeline-centric approach integrates with popular tools, and a managed cloud adds collaboration, governance, and enterprise support.

name: Zentist
description: Zentist provides an AI-powered dental revenue cycle management platform focused on dental support organizations (DSOs) and multi-site dental practices in the US.

name: Zype
description: Zype provides an API-first video infrastructure solution that lets media companies manage, monetize, and distribute video content across web, mobile, and other platforms.
